rows.disposition: The item needs no Schedule 5 record (Sch 5 p27 does not list it); the evidence findings apply to 'a record required by Schedule 5' (Cl.46, Cl.47 p8), and Cl.42 (p8) does not require an application line to cite a record. The cited record's other date / area / item therefore has no consequence under Cl.46-47; its effect is that it is not the classification of this excavation (S4 p10; Cl.5 p3), which reader and engine agree on: every ground class carried (owner G5), ground_differs_from_record unresolved, and the line payable. The engine states the mismatch in its reading (B1). The reader's own note on each case says the mismatch 'does not stop payment'.
